resources.string: Automatically classifies downloaded files and sorts them into Organized/Installers, Documents, Images, Audio, Videos, Archives, and Other in the background.
Runs locally on-device with a persistent recovery journal and Undo support
All Files Access lets S26 Download Organizer read new files in Downloads and move them into Organized/ category folders on your phone. Everything runs locally and never leaves your device.
Tap Open Settings and allow access for S26 Download Organizer. If a list of apps opens, choose this app. Return here when finished; access will be checked again.
Storage settings could not be opened. Open your phone’s Settings, find Special app access → All files access, and choose S26 Download Organizer. Return here to check access again.
Downloads organization requires Android 11 or newer. On Android 8–10, the dashboard is available but Downloads access is not supported.
